required_evidence: Charter; internal-use audience; funding; named reviewers; source/hosting route
required_reviews: Parent capital approval; TD scope acceptance; parent security owner
decision_rule: Proceed to baseline only with protected capacity and a feasible lawful-source route

required_evidence: 400 reviewed examples; 20 development families; ingestion/retrieval/tools; train-reload-serve smoke test
decision_rule: No unauthorized-source retrieval; correct typed tools; verified image preprocessing and repeatable serving

required_evidence: Paired image/OCR results; review-time and cost comparison; rights and lineage audit

decision_rule: At least 5 pp acceptance gain or 15% review-time reduction at matched quality; uncertainty supports benefit; otherwise use text/extraction

required_evidence: 2000-example snapshot; 300-family manifests; development ablations; candidate export
required_reviews: TD content acceptance and independent split audit
decision_rule: Tuning adds at least 5 pp acceptance or 15% review-time reduction without critical regression; otherwise retain untuned system

required_evidence: Locked evaluation; security tests; training/release manifests; restore and rollback evidence
required_reviews: TD technical acceptance and parent security acceptance mandatory
decision_rule: All proposed technical thresholds and hard vetoes pass; no unresolved high-severity issue

required_evidence: Four-week pilot; target 10 users and 100 reviewed briefs; value/cost report
required_reviews: TD pilot quality acceptance; board recommendation
decision_rule: Continue only with accepted scope, observed quality and viable cost; parent approves further capital
